decisive_items: episodes of dream enactment became progressively more violent
Figure Title: Rapid Eye Movement Behavior Disorder and Violent Events
response.rationale: R2 and R1 both identify RBD, but R2 includes the figure title as direct support and has broader generator assessments. R3 (OSA) is present on PSG but does not explain the violent dream enactment, which is the presenting complaint.

rejected.why: OSA is an incidental PSG finding; the clinical picture of violent dream enactment and self-injury is characteristic of RBD, not OSA.
